notes:
たくさん expresses a large quantity, usable as both adverb and noun.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As adverb: たくさん⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (eat a lot)
- As noun: たくさん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (many people)
- With が: たくさん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ is less common; use たくさん⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧
- たくさん⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: there are many
- たくさん〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: do something a lot
- たくさん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: many/much (noun modifier)

USAGE:
Can modify both countable and uncountable nouns.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: many (adjective, cannot directly modify nouns: ×⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧)
- ⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧: full, lots (more casual)
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: large quantity of (formal)
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧: a little
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧: a bit (casual)
